noetic-sample-g3-01.prompt: An eraser was placed on a correctly solved addition problem, as shown: $67 + \square = 92$. What number did it cover up?

noetic-sample-g3-02.prompt: Victor sends 6 text messages a day to each of his 8 friends. What is the total number of text messages he sends to his friends in 3 days?

noetic-sample-g3-03.prompt: How many 3-digit numbers can you make using digits 0, 2 and 9 if you can use each digit exactly once in each number?

noetic-sample-g3-04.prompt: Jeff left home in March 1999 to tour the world. He returned exactly 40 months later. Which month of the year did he return home?

noetic-sample-g3-05.prompt: The following scale is balanced. If the tennis ball weighs 60 g and the two books weigh the same, how much does each book weigh?
